subject: COLLATING SEQUENCE clause
notes: Alphabet-name-3 applies to record keys identified by data-name-1 or record-key-name-1. ResolveKeyCollating resolves each key's weight table from the Format-2 clause naming it before falling back to the Format-1 default (GR2) and then to native (GR4/GR5). The golden gives the prime key the alphabet REV and the alternate key DREV in the same file control entry and reads the file back on each key: the two halves order DIFFERENTLY (Z,M,A against 3,2,1 = A,Z,M), so neither can pass with the other's sequence applied and neither can pass with native ordinal weights.
